schema_scope.schema_claim: Phase 4 dev/mock projection, FTS, checkpoint, and identity-alias schema

evidence_scope: Executed QA covers Nix full suite, disposable PostgreSQL full suite, targeted Phase 4 checks, 21 labeled E2E/P4 scenarios, browser rendering, and accessibility checks. Evidence is repository-local and non-production.
scope_note: Product brief E2E-001..E2E-010 and planner P4-01..P4-11 were not present as labeled source files. IDs below preserve requested scenario labels and map behaviors to available repository evidence; missing labeled specs remain a traceability gap.

runs.expected: Authority commit feeds projection, PostgreSQL FTS/query, and barrier freshness.
runs.observed: Disposable PostgreSQL worker, FTS query, checkpoint, and fresh barrier checks passed.

runs.expected: tenant/source/source_id identity isolates objects and provenance aliases.
runs.observed: Identity dimensions isolate in local and disposable PostgreSQL authority checks; collision fails closed.

runs.expected: Search immediately after authority commit observes required freshness boundary.
runs.observed: Disposable PostgreSQL barrier rejects search below required applied sequence.

runs.expected: update, duplicate, conflict, gap, and delete preserve revision semantics.
runs.observed: Disposable PostgreSQL projection accepts newer revision, rejects stale replay, and retains delete tombstone.

runs.expected: Replay and purge do not resurrect deleted objects.
runs.observed: Local replay/tombstone/purge and disposable PostgreSQL tombstone checks passed.

runs.expected: Citation/provenance verifies current authority revision, ACL, and raw content hash.
runs.observed: Disposable PostgreSQL check accepts current citation and rejects tenant, hash, and authority-revision mismatch.

runs.expected: Failure injection retries, reaches dead-letter, and supports replay recovery.
runs.observed: Disposable PostgreSQL worker reaches bounded DLQ and recovers through authorized replay without authority mutation.

runs.expected: Evidence artifact records scenario, environment, schema, commit, and non-production boundary.
runs.observed: Ledger and runbook record runtime, migration schema, commit, evidence scope, and production_qualification=false.

runs.expected: Frontend observation renders read-only authority/projection/FTS ledger without mutation controls.
runs.observed: Browser render passed with read-only label and observation ledger; favicon request returned 404.

runs.expected: Frontend observational surface exposes keyboard/accessibility semantics and meaningful status text.
runs.observed: Browser/accessibility checks passed; headings, regions, table headers, live status, and keyboard-focusable controls were exposed.

runs.expected: Semantic identity uses tenant/source/source_id.
runs.observed: Pass.

runs.expected: Replay envelope is deterministic and round-trippable.
runs.observed: Pass.

runs.expected: Projection schema supports derived document, FTS, checkpoint, and aliases.
runs.observed: Migration 006 applied idempotently on disposable PostgreSQL.

runs.expected: Tenant/source ACL filtering occurs before result limiting.
runs.observed: Disposable PostgreSQL query returns authorized tenant row despite higher-ranked unauthorized rows.

runs.expected: PostgreSQL FTS query returns bounded provenance DTOs.
runs.observed: Disposable PostgreSQL FTS source filter returns bounded QueryResultDTO with provenance.

runs.expected: Barrier never reports fresh before minimum applied sequence.
runs.observed: Fresh/pending/stale/blocked/timeout behavior passed.

runs.expected: Projection tombstone and revision guards prevent stale resurrection.
runs.observed: Disposable PostgreSQL worker update/delete/replay checks passed.

runs.expected: Citation verification rejects stale revision, tombstone, ACL, or hash mismatch.
runs.observed: Disposable PostgreSQL citation check rejects tenant, hash, and authority revision mismatch.

runs.expected: Injected projection failure remains retryable and dead-letter/replay evidence is observable.
runs.observed: Failure remains bounded and observable through DLQ; authorized replay advances watermark; stale upsert cannot resurrect tombstone.

runs.expected: QA evidence is reproducible and explicitly non-production.
runs.observed: Nix and disposable PostgreSQL suites passed; ledger/runbook carry production_qualification=false.

runs.expected: Frontend observation and accessibility checks pass; visualization remains observational.
runs.observed: Browser and accessibility checks passed; visualization remains read-only. Favicon 404 remains P3.
